input: A unit may commit the order "hold", "move" or "retreat" only when its own /world/<A>/in_range.num is 0, so that any unit with an enemy in range must commit "attack" on /world/focus.text every half second instead of idling or splitting its fire. (Writing the formula: num_*, bool_* and text_* predicates read the contract's accepted state, from before the commit being checked, so they never see the value a commit writes. To test the order a commit writes, use +sets(/orders/<unit>.text, "<order>"). Paths: /world/step.num /world/allies_alive.num /world/enemies_alive.num /world/focus.text /world/<unit>/hp.num /world/<unit>/alive.bool /world/<A>/closest.text /world/<A>/in_range.num /orders/<A>.text)
response: always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "hold") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "move") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "retreat") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false)
